# pastclim

This `R` library is designed to provide an easy way to extract and
manipulate climate data for ecological and anthropological analyses. The
package gives access to multiple datasets of present observations,
palaeoclimate reconstructions, and future projections from multiple
climate models.

The functionalities of `pastclim` are described in [Leonardi et al.
(2023)](https://doi.org/10.1111/ecog.06481). Please cite it if you use
`pastclim` in your research.

## Install the library

`pastclim` is on CRAN, and the easiest way to install it is with:

    install.packages("pastclim")

The version on CRAN is recommended for every day use. New features and
bug fixes appear first on the `dev` branch on GitHub, before they make
their way to CRAN. If you need to have early access to these new
features, you can install the development version of `pastclim` directly
from GitHub, using `devtools`, or more simply get a compiled version
from r-universe. Also, note that the `dev` version of `pastclim` tracks
changes in the `dev` version of `terra`, so you will need to upgrade
both libraries with:

    install.packages('terra', repos='https://rspatial.r-universe.dev')
    install.packages("pastclim", repos = c("https://evolecolgroup.r-universe.dev")

## Overview of functionality

On its dedicated [website](https://evolecolgroup.github.io/pastclim/),
you can find Articles giving you a step-by-step [overview of the
package](https://evolecolgroup.github.io/pastclim/articles/a0_pastclim_overview.html),
and a
[cheatsheet](https://evolecolgroup.github.io/pastclim/pastclim_cheatsheet.pdf).
There is also a [dev
version](https://evolecolgroup.github.io/pastclim/dev/) of the site
updated for the `dev` branch of `pastclim` (on the top left of the dev
website, the version number is in red and in the format x.x.x.9xxx,
indicating it is a development version).

`pastclim` currently includes data from Beyer et al 2020 (a
reconstruction of climate based on the HadCM3 model for the last 120k
years), Krapp et al 2021 (which covers the last 800k years with a
statistical emulator of HadCM3), Barreto et al 2023 (covering the last
5M years using the PALEO-PGEM emulator), PaleoClim (providing a few time
steps from different palaeoclimate models downscaled to higher
resolution), CHELSA-Trace21K (a transient reconstruction of the last 21k
years, downscaled to 1km resolution), the HYDE3.3 database of land use
reconstructions for the last 10k years, and the WorldClim and CHELSA
data (present, and future projections with a number of models and
emission scenarios). More details on each of these datasets can be found
[here](https://evolecolgroup.github.io/pastclim/articles/a1_available_datasets.html).
There are also instructions on how to build and use [custom
datasets](https://evolecolgroup.github.io/pastclim/articles/a2_custom_datasets.html).

------------------------------------------------------------------------

## Getting help

There are two places to get help with `pastclim`:

1.  If you are unsure how to do something, go to
    [StackOverflow](https://stackoverflow.com/) and, after checking that
    a similar question has not been asked yet, tag your question with
    `terra` and `r` (there is no `pastclim` tag yet, as there aren’t
    enough questions), and make sure `pastclim` is in the title. This
    will ensure that the developers see your question and can help you.
    If you have not received an answer after a couple of days, feel free
    to drop us an email in case we missed your post.

2.  If you think you have found a bug, or have a feature request, please
    open an issue on our \[GitHub
    repository\]((<https://github.com/EvolEcolGroup/pastclim/issues>).
    Before doing so, please make sure that you have installed the latest
    **development** version of `pastclim` (as the bug might have already
    been fixed), as well as updating all other packages on your system.
    If the problem persists, and there is no issue already opened that
    deals with your bug, file a new issue **providing** a [reproducible
    example](https://reprex.tidyverse.org/) for the developers to
    investigate the problem. A small **reproducible example** is crucial
    in allowing us to understand the problem and fix it, so please do
    your best to come up with the shortest bit of code needed to show
    the bug.

# Package index

## All functions

- [`Barreto2023`](https://evolecolgroup.github.io/pastclim/dev/reference/Barreto2023.md)
  : Documentation for the Barreto et al 2023 dataset

- [`Beyer2020`](https://evolecolgroup.github.io/pastclim/dev/reference/Beyer2020.md)
  : Documentation for the Beyer2020 dataset

- [`CHELSA_2.1`](https://evolecolgroup.github.io/pastclim/dev/reference/CHELSA_2.1.md)
  :

  Documentation for *CHELSA 2.1*

- [`CHELSA_trace21k_1.0`](https://evolecolgroup.github.io/pastclim/dev/reference/CHELSA_trace21k_1.0.md)
  [`CHELSA_trace21k_1.0_0.5m_vsi`](https://evolecolgroup.github.io/pastclim/dev/reference/CHELSA_trace21k_1.0.md)
  :

  Documentation for *CHELSA-TracCE21k*

- [`Example`](https://evolecolgroup.github.io/pastclim/dev/reference/Example.md)
  : Documentation for the Example dataset

- [`HYDE_3.3_baseline`](https://evolecolgroup.github.io/pastclim/dev/reference/HYDE_3.3_baseline.md)
  :

  Documentation for *HYDE 3.3* dataset

- [`Krapp2021`](https://evolecolgroup.github.io/pastclim/dev/reference/Krapp2021.md)
  : Documentation for the Krapp2021 dataset

- [`WorldClim_2.1`](https://evolecolgroup.github.io/pastclim/dev/reference/WorldClim_2.1.md)
  : Documentation for the WorldClim datasets

- [`bioclim_vars()`](https://evolecolgroup.github.io/pastclim/dev/reference/bioclim_vars-methods.md)
  : Compute bioclimatic variables

- [`biome4_classes`](https://evolecolgroup.github.io/pastclim/dev/reference/biome4_classes.md)
  : BIOME4 classes.

- [`clean_data_path()`](https://evolecolgroup.github.io/pastclim/dev/reference/clean_data_path.md)
  : Clean the data path

- [`climate_for_locations()`](https://evolecolgroup.github.io/pastclim/dev/reference/climate_for_locations.md)
  : Extract local climate for one or more locations for a given time
  slice.

- [`climate_for_time_slice()`](https://evolecolgroup.github.io/pastclim/dev/reference/climate_for_time_slice.md)
  : Extract a climate slice for a region

- [`delta_compute()`](https://evolecolgroup.github.io/pastclim/dev/reference/delta_compute.md)
  : Compute a delta raster.

- [`delta_downscale()`](https://evolecolgroup.github.io/pastclim/dev/reference/delta_downscale.md)
  : Downscale using the delta method

- [`df_from_region_series()`](https://evolecolgroup.github.io/pastclim/dev/reference/df_from_region_series.md)
  : Extract data frame from a region series

- [`df_from_region_slice()`](https://evolecolgroup.github.io/pastclim/dev/reference/df_from_region_slice.md)
  : Extract data frame from a region slice

- [`distance_from_sea()`](https://evolecolgroup.github.io/pastclim/dev/reference/distance_from_sea.md)
  : Compute a raster of distances from the sea for each land pixel.

- [`download_dataset()`](https://evolecolgroup.github.io/pastclim/dev/reference/download_dataset.md)
  : Download palaeoclimate reconstructions.

- [`download_etopo()`](https://evolecolgroup.github.io/pastclim/dev/reference/download_etopo.md)
  : Download the ETOPO Global relief model

- [`downscale_ice_mask()`](https://evolecolgroup.github.io/pastclim/dev/reference/downscale_ice_mask.md)
  : Downscale an ice mask

- [`get_available_datasets()`](https://evolecolgroup.github.io/pastclim/dev/reference/get_available_datasets.md)
  : Get the available datasets.

- [`get_biome_classes()`](https://evolecolgroup.github.io/pastclim/dev/reference/get_biome_classes.md)
  : Get the biome classes for a dataset.

- [`get_data_path()`](https://evolecolgroup.github.io/pastclim/dev/reference/get_data_path.md)
  : Get the data path where climate reconstructions are stored

- [`get_downloaded_datasets()`](https://evolecolgroup.github.io/pastclim/dev/reference/get_downloaded_datasets.md)
  : Get the variables downloaded for each dataset.

- [`get_ice_mask()`](https://evolecolgroup.github.io/pastclim/dev/reference/get_ice_mask.md)
  : Get the ice mask for a dataset.

- [`get_land_mask()`](https://evolecolgroup.github.io/pastclim/dev/reference/get_land_mask.md)
  : Get the land mask for a dataset.

- [`get_mis_time_steps()`](https://evolecolgroup.github.io/pastclim/dev/reference/get_mis_time_steps.md)
  : Get time steps for a given MIS

- [`get_resolution()`](https://evolecolgroup.github.io/pastclim/dev/reference/get_resolution.md)
  : Get resolution of a given dataset

- [`get_time_bp_steps()`](https://evolecolgroup.github.io/pastclim/dev/reference/get_time_bp_steps.md)
  [`get_time_ce_steps()`](https://evolecolgroup.github.io/pastclim/dev/reference/get_time_bp_steps.md)
  [`get_time_steps()`](https://evolecolgroup.github.io/pastclim/dev/reference/get_time_bp_steps.md)
  : Get time steps for a given dataset

- [`get_vars_for_dataset()`](https://evolecolgroup.github.io/pastclim/dev/reference/get_vars_for_dataset.md)
  : Get a list of variables for a given dataset.

- [`is_region_series()`](https://evolecolgroup.github.io/pastclim/dev/reference/is_region_series.md)
  : Check the object is a valid region series

- [`koeppen_classes`](https://evolecolgroup.github.io/pastclim/dev/reference/koeppen_classes.md)
  : Koeppen-Geiger classes.

- [`koeppen_geiger()`](https://evolecolgroup.github.io/pastclim/dev/reference/koeppen_geiger-methods.md)
  : Reconstruct biomes based on the Köppen Geiger's classification

- [`list_available_datasets()`](https://evolecolgroup.github.io/pastclim/dev/reference/list_available_datasets.md)
  : List all the available datasets.

- [`load_etopo()`](https://evolecolgroup.github.io/pastclim/dev/reference/load_etopo.md)
  : Load the ETOPO global relief

- [`location_series()`](https://evolecolgroup.github.io/pastclim/dev/reference/location_series.md)
  : Extract a time series of bioclimatic variables for one or more
  locations.

- [`location_slice()`](https://evolecolgroup.github.io/pastclim/dev/reference/location_slice.md)
  : Extract local climate for one or more locations for a given time
  slice.

- [`location_slice_from_region_series()`](https://evolecolgroup.github.io/pastclim/dev/reference/location_slice_from_region_series.md)
  : Extract local climate for one or more locations for a given time
  slice.

- [`make_land_mask()`](https://evolecolgroup.github.io/pastclim/dev/reference/make_land_mask.md)
  : Create a land mask

- [`mis_boundaries`](https://evolecolgroup.github.io/pastclim/dev/reference/mis_boundaries.md)
  : Time boundaries of marine isotope stages (MIS).

- [`paleoclim_1.0`](https://evolecolgroup.github.io/pastclim/dev/reference/paleoclim_1.0.md)
  [`paleoclim_1.0_10m`](https://evolecolgroup.github.io/pastclim/dev/reference/paleoclim_1.0.md)
  [`paleoclim_1.0_5m`](https://evolecolgroup.github.io/pastclim/dev/reference/paleoclim_1.0.md)
  [`paleoclim_1.0_2.5m`](https://evolecolgroup.github.io/pastclim/dev/reference/paleoclim_1.0.md)
  :

  Documentation for *Paleoclim*

- [`region_extent`](https://evolecolgroup.github.io/pastclim/dev/reference/region_extent.md)
  : Region extents.

- [`region_outline`](https://evolecolgroup.github.io/pastclim/dev/reference/region_outline.md)
  : Region outlines.

- [`region_outline_union`](https://evolecolgroup.github.io/pastclim/dev/reference/region_outline_union.md)
  : Region outlines unioned.

- [`region_series()`](https://evolecolgroup.github.io/pastclim/dev/reference/region_series.md)
  : Extract a time series of climate variables for a region

- [`region_slice()`](https://evolecolgroup.github.io/pastclim/dev/reference/region_slice.md)
  : Extract a climate slice for a region

- [`sample_region_series()`](https://evolecolgroup.github.io/pastclim/dev/reference/sample_region_series.md)
  : Sample points from a region time series

- [`sample_region_slice()`](https://evolecolgroup.github.io/pastclim/dev/reference/sample_region_slice.md)
  : Sample points from a region time slice

- [`set_data_path()`](https://evolecolgroup.github.io/pastclim/dev/reference/set_data_path.md)
  : Set the data path where climate reconstructions will be stored

- [`slice_region_series()`](https://evolecolgroup.github.io/pastclim/dev/reference/slice_region_series.md)
  : Extract a slice for a time series of climate variables for a region

- [`time_bp()`](https://evolecolgroup.github.io/pastclim/dev/reference/time_bp.md)
  [`` `time_bp<-`() ``](https://evolecolgroup.github.io/pastclim/dev/reference/time_bp.md)
  : Extract and set time in years before present for SpatRaster and
  SpatRasterDataset

- [`time_series_for_locations()`](https://evolecolgroup.github.io/pastclim/dev/reference/time_series_for_locations.md)
  : Extract a time series of bioclimatic variables for one or more
  locations.

- [`update_dataset_list()`](https://evolecolgroup.github.io/pastclim/dev/reference/update_dataset_list.md)
  : Update the dataset list

- [`validate_nc()`](https://evolecolgroup.github.io/pastclim/dev/reference/validate_nc.md)
  : Validate an netcdf file for pastclim

- [`var_labels()`](https://evolecolgroup.github.io/pastclim/dev/reference/var_labels.md)
  : Generate pretty variable labels for plotting

- [`ybp2date()`](https://evolecolgroup.github.io/pastclim/dev/reference/ybp2date.md)
  [`date2ybp()`](https://evolecolgroup.github.io/pastclim/dev/reference/ybp2date.md)
  : Convert years BP from pastclim to lubridate date, or vice versa
